lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Walking through the pines where the shadows start to lean
Tracing every whisper in the spaces in between
The twilight is a blanket draped in shades of deep indigo
Finding hidden rhythms in the pulse of the garden flow
I’m mapping out the memories like stars inside a jar
Healing every bruise and every little jagged scar
The ground beneath my feet is a secret I can keep
Waking up the spirit while the rest of the world sleeps
[Chorus]
Under the canopy of silver and gold
Watching the secrets of the night unfold
I am breathing in the light, finding my way
Where the shadows dance and the giants sway
[Verse]
Every leaf is a page in a book I haven't read
Chasing every spark of the fire that the forest fed
The air is thick with the scent of moss and ancient stone
I’m finding pieces of myself I thought were left alone
The roots are reaching deep like the anchors of my soul
Moving with the current, feeling steady, feeling whole
One step forward, one step back into the unknown maze
Breaking through the fog and the heavy, heavy haze
[Chorus]
Under the canopy of silver and gold
Watching the secrets of the night unfold
I am breathing in the light, finding my way
Where the shadows dance and the giants sway
[Bridge]
The wind whispers a name I almost forgot
Finding peace in the stillness of a lonely plot
[Chorus]
Under the canopy of silver and gold
Watching the secrets of the night unfold
I am breathing in the light, finding my way
Where the shadows dance and the giants sway
[Outro]
